get.description: Your personal lists and the lists of every household you are in, with their items. A list with a `householdId` is shared with that household; one without is only yours.

post.summary: Make a shopping list
post.description: Send `householdId` to share the list with a household you are in; leave it out for a personal list. You may choose the `id` yourself (a UUID): sending the same id again returns the existing list, which makes a retry after a lost connection safe.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

409.description: That id is already used by another list

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

patch.description: Everyone who can see the list can rename it.

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

delete.description: The person who made the list can delete it. For a household list, the household's owners can too.

403.description: Only the person who made the list or a household owner can delete it

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add an item to a list
post.description: Adds one line as written. `quantity` stays null when you don't give an amount. You may choose the item's `id`; sending the same id again changes nothing.

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

409.description: That id is already used by another item

200.description: The list without the ticked-off items

404.description: The list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

patch.summary: Change or tick off an item
patch.description: Only the fields you send change. Send `checked` to tick an item on or off.

404.description: The list or the item doesn't exist, or you can't see it
The list or the item doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add a recipe's ingredients to a list
post.description: Scales the amounts to `servings` (the recipe's own servings by default) and merges identical ingredients: the same name with the same unit adds up (200 g + 100 g flour is 300 g). Different units stay on separate lines, and an ingredient without an amount is added without one. Ingredients on the pantry list of the list's space (your own, or the household's) are left out and returned in `skipped`. You need to be able to see the recipe.

200.description: The list with the ingredients added

skipped.description: Names of the ingredients that were left out because they are on the pantry list

404.description: The list or the recipe doesn't exist, or you can't see it

get.description: Your own chores and the chores of your households. With `householdId`, only the chores of that household. Every chore has `lastDoneOn` and `intervalDays`; a chore is due again on `lastDoneOn` + `intervalDays` days, from 00:00. The app works that out on the device, in the time zone of the person.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

post.summary: Add a chore
post.description: `householdId` shares the chore with a household; without it the chore is personal. You may choose the `id`. Sending an id that already exists returns that chore and changes nothing. A new chore is due right away.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

409.description: That id is already used by someone else's chore

patch.summary: Change a chore, check it off or undo a check
patch.description: Everyone who can see the chore can change it. To check a chore off, send `lastDoneOn` with the day it was done (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the person's local date). To undo it, send the earlier day, or `null` when it was never done.

404.description: The chore doesn't exist, or you can't see it

delete.description: Everyone who can see the chore can delete it.

404.description: The chore doesn't exist, or you can't see it

get.description: The things you always have at home. They are left out when a recipe's ingredients are added to a shopping list. Without `householdId` this is your own pantry; with it, the pantry of that household. A pantry is made with the default list the first time it is needed. `language` (`en`, `de`, `es`, `fr` or `it`) picks the default list's language.

post.summary: Add a pantry staple
post.description: Names are compared without upper/lower case and extra spaces, so adding "salt" when "Salt" is there returns the existing one. You may choose the `id`. Without `householdId` this is your own pantry; with it, the pantry of that household. A pantry is made with the default list the first time it is needed. `language` (`en`, `de`, `es`, `fr` or `it`) picks the default list's language.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

409.description: That id is already used by another item

404.description: The item doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Reset the pantry to the default list
post.description: Replaces the whole list. Items that were added are removed. Without `householdId` this is your own pantry; with it, the pantry of that household. A pantry is made with the default list the first time it is needed. `language` (`en`, `de`, `es`, `fr` or `it`) picks the default list's language.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

get.description: Your personal plans and the plans of every household you are in. The meals are left out; get one plan to see them.

post.summary: Make a meal plan
post.description: Send `householdId` to share the plan with a household you are in; leave it out for a personal plan. A plan has no fixed length: it holds meals for any days, so you can plan weeks ahead.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

409.description: That id is already used by another plan

get.summary: Get a meal plan with its meals
get.description: Every meal is a recipe in one of three slots of a day: `breakfast`, `midday` or `afternoon`. A slot can hold several meals. Use `from` and `to` to get only some days. Calories are an estimate per serving.

schema.description: Only meals from this day on (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.description: Only meals from this day on (YYYY-MM-DD).
parameters.name: from

schema.description: Only meals up to and including this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.description: Only meals up to and including this day (YYYY-MM-DD).
parameters.name: to

404.description: The plan doesn't exist, or you can't see it

patch.description: Everyone who can see the plan can rename it.

404.description: The plan doesn't exist, or you can't see it

delete.description: The person who made the plan can delete it. For a household plan, the household's owners can too.

403.description: Only the person who made the plan or a household owner can delete it

404.description: The plan doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add a recipe to a slot
post.description: A slot can hold several recipes, for example a bread and a smoothie for breakfast. The recipe is added next to what is already there. Adding a recipe that is already in the slot changes its servings instead of adding it twice. A household plan can only use the household's recipes, so that every member can open them. A personal plan can use your own recipes and your households'.

200.description: The plan with the meal added

404.description: The plan or the recipe doesn't exist, or you can't use it

put.summary: Put one recipe in a slot
put.description: Makes the recipe the only meal of the slot: everything else in that slot is taken out. To keep what is there, add a recipe with POST instead.

200.description: The plan with the meal set

404.description: The plan or the recipe doesn't exist, or you can't use it

delete.description: Takes out every meal of the slot. To remove one meal, use its id.

404.description: The plan doesn't exist, or nothing is planned in that slot

patch.description: Change the servings, swap the recipe, or both. The meal stays in its slot and keeps its place. A recipe that is already in that slot can't be used twice.

200.description: The plan with the changed meal

404.description: The plan, the meal or the recipe doesn't exist, or you can't use it

409.description: That recipe is already in this slot, or it is the batch of a meal prep

delete.description: Other meals in the same slot stay.

404.description: The plan or the meal doesn't exist

post.summary: Plan meal prep: cook once, eat it in several slots
post.description: Cook a recipe in one slot (`date`, `slot`) and eat it again in the slots of `eat`, which must come after the cooking meal. Every meal has its own servings: the cooking meal's plus all the leftovers' servings is what is cooked. A meal in the answer has `prep`: `cook` on the cooking meal (with the whole batch) and `leftover` on the others. When the plan is added to a shopping list, the batch is bought once, with the cooking meal. A recipe that is already in one of the slots is linked to the batch. Calling it again for the same cooking meal adds more days.

200.description: The plan with the meal prep

404.description: The plan or the recipe doesn't exist, or you can't use it

409.description: A slot is a leftover of another batch, or already has leftovers of its own

delete.summary: End meal prep for a meal
delete.description: Send the id of the cooking meal to turn all its leftovers into ordinary meals, or the id of one leftover to take only that meal out of the batch. No meal is deleted, but each meal that stops being a leftover is then bought for on its own when the plan is added to a shopping list.

200.description: The plan without that meal prep

404.description: The plan or the meal doesn't exist, or it is not part of a meal prep

post.summary: Fill days automatically from your saved recipes
post.description: Plain code, not AI: the same wishes give the same plan, whichever AI provider (or none) the server uses. Wishes: `caloriesPerDay`, `diet` (a tag) and `maxMinutes`. `days` lists the days to fill; a day can be skipped (`skip`), have meals skipped (`skipSlots`) or its own `servings`. By default only empty slots are filled; `overwrite` replaces planned meals. Recipes that lack the data a wish needs (a calorie estimate, a cooking time) are skipped, never guessed. When nothing matches, the slot stays empty and is listed in `unfilled`. Calories are estimates.

200.description: The plan, and the slots that stayed empty

404.description: The plan doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Add the plan's ingredients to a shopping list
post.description: Nothing is added to a list unless you call this. Every meal's ingredients are scaled to its servings and merged into the list like a recipe is. A meal prep is bought once: the cooking meal adds the ingredients for the whole batch and its leftovers add nothing, so choose days that include the cooking day. Use `from` and `to` to take only some days.

404.description: The plan or the list doesn't exist, or you can't see it

post.summary: Complete a partial recipe with AI
post.description: Takes a free-form message that says what is missing (for example `add a pizza dough`) and returns the recipe's ingredients and steps with the AI's additions merged in. The existing ingredients and steps stay exactly as they are. Nothing is saved: send the result to `PUT /recipes/{recipeId}` once the person has checked it.

200.description: The recipe with the additions, and which ones are new

400.description: Invalid message, or the AI had nothing to add

404.description: The recipe doesn't exist, or you can't see it

503.description: No AI key is set on this server

post.summary: Add a recipe from a video or website link
post.description: Queues a job that reads the link (Instagram Reel, TikTok, YouTube Short or a recipe website) and saves the result as a recipe. Websites with recipe data need no AI key.

202.description: The job was queued. Poll `GET /extractions/{jobId}` for the result.

400.description: Unsupported or invalid link, or an address on a private network

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

503.description: No AI key is set on this server

post.summary: Add a recipe from pasted text

202.description: The job was queued. Poll `GET /extractions/{jobId}` for the result.

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

503.description: No AI key is set on this server

post.summary: Add a recipe from a photo or screenshot

202.description: The job was queued. Poll `GET /extractions/{jobId}` for the result.

400.description: Not an image, empty, or too large

404.description: Household not found, or you are not a member

503.description: No AI key is set on this server

get.summary: Check a job and get its result
get.description: `status` is `queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or `failed`. When it succeeded, `recipe` is the saved recipe. When it failed, `error` says why.

404.description: The job doesn't exist, or it is not yours
